**A hotfix for v0.8.** Three new F4 choices, from your feedback, and one
automap fix. Everything else plays as before.

**Random time of day.** F4 → Game → World → Weather → Time of day has a new
choice, Random. Each map rolls its own hour from dawn to night and keeps your
weather, temperature and wind. It only picks hours that suit the temperature
you chose, so 50 °C never lands at night. In a level the row shows this map's
roll, for example "Random (Dusk)". Deaths and loaded saves keep the hour, and a
new game rolls again. Random weather still rolls everything, the hour included.

**DOOM's own sound in one go.** F4 → Sound → Effects starts with a new row,
Sounds. DOOM's own turns off every sound DERP adds and every change it makes to
how sound carries: the made-up sparks, glass, footsteps and ambience, the
monsters' voices, room echoes, muffling behind walls, dulling with distance and
the natural falloff. Default puts them back. Your music, output and random
pitch stay as they are. Change any of them by hand and the row reads Custom.

**Monster voices.** In DERP mode the soldiers shout what they are about to do
and the imps hiss and call to each other. The new Monster voices switch in
F4 → Sound → Made-up sounds turns that off, and every monster makes DOOM's own
sounds again. The monsters think and act as before; you just don't hear them
say it.

**Vanilla explosions with the new muzzle flash.** This was already possible,
but the setting is easy to miss. In F4 → Graphics → Combat → Shots, set
Explosions to "Doom's sprite" and leave Muzzle flash on.

**The automap marks only what you saw.** It used to mark walls behind you and
off to the sides as soon as you entered an area. Now it marks a wall the way
DOOM does: when some of it was actually in view.

## Known issue

- **Odd lighting after a mid-level change.** A light switch or similar change
  in the middle of a level can light the area oddly. Cycling through the F4
  presets fixes it.
